quote.text: Nothing is more abstract than reality.
quote.english: Nothing is more abstract than reality.

poem.text:
古池や
蛙飛びこむ
水の音
poem.roman: furu ike ya / kawazu tobikomu / mizu no oto
poem.english:
the old pond —
a frog jumps in,
the sound of water
poem.note: The most famous poem in Japanese. His students argued for years about the first line; he kept the plainest one.
poem.translator: translated for this page, not a published version

painting.title: Still Life
painting.note: self-taught, painted on oilcloth for taverns in tbilisi: animals, feasts, a deer looking back. he sold them for meals. the still lifes are as plain as a table after the guests have gone.

song.title: Peace Piece
song.note: One left-hand figure, held for seven minutes, improvised in a single take at the end of a session.
